correctness.rationale: Positive site deletion and disjoint Bell additions make finite partial-matching chain irreducible. Detailed balance on add/delete edges uniquely forces matching-product measure. Single-edge rewiring automatically obeys its balance equations. Double-edge reconnection has both Bell selections, giving exact fourpoint inverse-rate identity, equivalent by explicit reconstruction to vertex-additive 1/w. The oriented five-matching Kolmogorov cycle has ratio (1/w_ab+1/w_cd)/(1/w_ac+1/w_bd)=2^-alpha for four consecutive distance-weighted vertices. Independent exact rational check of cycle ratios for alpha=0,1,2; all-N proof is algebraic.

final_claim: For every N>=4, 0<p<1 and strictly positive state-independent pair weights, the matching-chain Bell/vertex measurement dynamics is reversible exactly when all reciprocal weights 1/w_ij are additive vertex potentials v_i+v_j. Then π(M)∝product[N(1-p)w_ij/(2pW)] and distance weights |i-j|^-alpha have exact nonzero five-cycle log affinity -alpha log2 for alpha>0.
limitations: Only finite partial matchings and outcome-averaged Bell labels, positive weights and 0<p<1; does not assert quantum trajectory or extensive entropy production.
The five-cycle ratio is an orientation-dependent Kolmogorov witness, not stationary entropy-production rate.
